facts.fact: Vero 认定去拿食物的 Kayla 失踪超时，推开大门独自沿路去找，并让 Brawley 看住 Clay 和 Ares
facts.anchor: “I’m hungry anyway. You keep those two alive until I get back,” I yell over my shoulder as I push through the gate.

facts.fact: Vero 在小径上发现被丢下的食物袋，食物撒了一地
facts.anchor: I freeze mid-step when I see the bag of food scattered on the path, our food spilled out everywhere.

facts.fact: Vero 跑回营地告诉 Brawley：生菜在地上、苹果滚离小径、Kayla 不在那儿，并把 Brawley 拖到丢袋处
facts.anchor: I rush straight into his arms. “There is lettuce, Brawley, on the ground. And the apples rolled off the path. But she’s not there.”

facts.fact: Clay 用无线电下令 Khodi 全面搜查全岛并禁止任何人进出岛；Khodi 回报这一侧的摄像头已坏
facts.anchor: He instructs Khodi to start an entire grounds check, and that no one is to enter or leave the island until we find her. Clay is too calm. Kayla is missing, and I want to scream at him. The radio crackles to life, and Khodi reports that the cameras on this side of the island are down.

facts.fact: Cave 从玉米地走出，Vero 看到他双手沾着干涸的血并当场指认他，Cave 不回答只抛出一个谜语
facts.anchor: “It was you,” I breathe, the rage building, ready to unleash itself. “What did you do?”

facts.fact: Ares 破出谜底后带众人奔向墓地，找到新挖的坟与沾血的铁锹，众人挖开棺材
facts.anchor: Ares shouts in alarm, and we all race to follow the direction of his voice, coming to a stop at the same time, facing a grave with freshly dug soil. There is a shovel beside it, blood coating the end.

facts.fact: Vero 情绪解离崩溃，抛下要救 Kayla 的众人跑走，并拿走 Noa 的砍刀冲向玉米地
facts.anchor: “Brawley, we need your help,” Clay says, and I run.

facts.fact: Vero 在玉米地中心发现 Luca 被绑在稻草人柱上、嘴被缝住；Cave 再出谜语把嫌疑指向 Luca，Vero 改信稻草人并把砍刀交给他，要他挖出自己后颈的芯片
facts.anchor: “Cut it out,” I say with finality.
